title: Grateful Dead Live at Charlotte Coliseum on 1991-06-11
source: Two source matrix: 70% sbd/30% aud with a few level adjustments; sbd: Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100/Tascam Deck); transferred and master by Charlie Miller; Resampled an dithered with iZotope RX 6 Advanced; and aud: B&K 4011 110 degrees ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro Recorded by James Young & Clay Brennecke, transferred by Todd Evans and mastered by Jamie Waddell; matrix created with Adobe Audition 1.5 SIRMick

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix mix captures a stellar show featuring a blazing Promised Land, Victim‑Looks Like Rain‑Throwing Stones stretch and an ecstatic Terrapin Station.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance – the first set closes with a powerful "The Promised Land" and the second set delivers a fire‑storm of classics (Victim, Looks Like Rain, Throwing Stone’s) plus a rousing U.S. Blues encore, all highlighted by Bruce Hornsby’s keyboards.  The matrix recording is praised as “awesome” and “crisp,” delivering a clear, well‑balanced listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong enthusiasm for both musical performance and matrix sound quality; limited to two detailed reviews but both are highly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the mix as awesome, clear and well‑balanced with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds to a strong closer with "The Promised Land"; second set is a high‑energy sequence of three classics plus an uplifting U.S. Blues encore, creating a seamless and exciting flow.

band_member_comments.Keys: Bruce Hornsby’s playing is specifically praised (“Love me a show with Bruce!”).
